static_result.interpretation: Syntax and whitespace passed; npm run lint could not run ESLint. No lint pass is claimed, and no dependency installation was attempted in this lane.

red_result.interpretation: Behavioral red: error/abort/synchronous read exceptions leave busy set; module and storage failures in restore/reset cause unhandled rejections. Valid restore/reset and both cancellation forms passed.

evidence.implementation_choice: Await file selection, then a FileReader loadend promise which covers success/error/abort and captures synchronous read exceptions; await dynamic import and restore in a single try/catch/finally. Reset similarly always clears busy. Reuse settings.js console.error convention; no new notification framework or transaction claim.
evidence.task: Bounded uBO Lite restore/reset recovery fix
evidence.initial_dirty_state: clean, confirmed 2026-11-22T14:13:56.772Z and subsequent completed git status --short notification
evidence.root_cause: Pinned settings.js creates an outer promise settled only by load/cancel paths. FileReader errors/abort and rejected dynamic imports do not settle it; restore/reset rejection skips removal of busy. dashboard.css hides normal sections while busy is present.
evidence.reachability: Restore and reset buttons in dashboard.html call the actual settings.js handlers. backup-restore.js performs direct localWrite/localRemove calls which may reject; ext.js sendMessage already swallows some other background rejections, so this fix cannot make all background failures observable.
